rrf_formula: score(doc) = sum_i w_i * boost_i(doc) / (k + rank_i(doc) + 1), rank_i=1-based
duplicate_handling: group by chunk_id; if present in multiple lists, scores are summed
ties: round to 6 decimals; stable by python sorted over insertion order of first occurrence
ordering: fused scores sorted descending, then low-quality filter, then re-rank
observation: BM25 is weighted like dense in current config; q15 lacked dense support, so RRF demoted
